svg.title: Envelope during septal constriction
svg.desc: Mycobacterial envelope in flat section at a division site: the plasma membrane folds inward around a septal peptidoglycan cross-wall with FtsZ filaments beneath, while arabinogalactan, mycomembrane and capsule still run straight above.
